title: Portal or wormhole theory for the ranch

tellings.quote: >> When Dr. Taylor and others speculate that there's a portal for portals or wormholes on Skinwalker Ranch,

plain: The idea is that Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah long known for reports of strange lights and events, may hold a portal or wormhole, a shortcut through space. Brandon Fugal, the businessman who owns the ranch, says this is speculation by a scientist he calls Dr. Taylor and others who study the place. If true, it would explain the ranch's strange events as things coming through from somewhere else.
